---
title: "Race and Ethnicity Heatmaps: Duval County, Jacksonville, and Florida"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

maps <- readRDS("race_ethnicity_maps_2024.rds")
```

## 1. Duval County, FL

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(maps$duval) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = percent / 100), color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    labels = label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Share of Population"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Race and Ethnicity in Duval County, FL",
    subtitle = "Share of census tract population · 2020–2024 ACS",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau (ACS Table B03002)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 2. Jacksonville, FL

## 3. State of Florida

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

ggplot(maps$florida) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = percent / 100), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    labels = label_percent(),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Share of Population"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Race and Ethnicity Across Florida",
    subtitle = "Share of county population · 2020–2024 ACS",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau (ACS Table B03002)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
